declarations: System picked from each name's own picture, never the lane tag (R10/R32). GRDN, G and VRDN read as position-system cases (C22, C26); none is judged by swing rules.

Declared proxies: last swing high for the resistance line, max(fib_swing_low, base_low_20d) for the support line, last_bar colour for the candle-colour flip. cmf (COM proxy) is not served in this packet.
No bracket field is a reason here (R1). C21 weekly read is a house rule, not the author's. No market-wide void exists in my method, so market_void is null.
